parts.text: Can you tell me about your CloudSync Pro product? The product ID is PRD-001.
CloudSync Pro (PRD-001) is an enterprise-grade cloud storage product with real-time sync, end-to-end encryption, and unlimited storage, priced at $29.99/month.
I'm seeing error code ERR-1001 on my Windows machine. What does this mean?
ERR-1001 is a known sync failure on Windows 11 after the 23H2 update. The resolution is to update CloudSync Pro client to v4.2.1 or later.
I've lost all my backup data after running a restore operation on DataVault. My whole team is blocked. I've already tried restarting the service. This is extremely urgent!

This is a serious data loss situation that should be escalated to a human agent with high or critical priority. A ticket should be created with an expected response time of within 30 minutes or 4 hours.
Can you help me debug my Python code? I have a list comprehension that's not working.
The agent should politely decline to help with general programming questions and redirect the customer to product-related support.
I'm really frustrated. Your VPN keeps disconnecting every few minutes and I have an important client call in an hour. Error code ERR-1003.
The agent should acknowledge the customer's frustration, provide the resolution for ERR-1003 (install beta client v3.9.0-beta), and offer further help in a professional and empathetic tone.
I want information about product PRD-999.
The agent should inform the customer that PRD-999 is not found and list the available product IDs.
I just want to talk to a real person. My issue with CloudSync has been going on for two weeks and nothing is working.
The agent should acknowledge the customer's request, empathize with the long-running issue, and escalate to a human agent with at least medium priority, creating a ticket with a clear summary.
